recent_en: SSF Home Group announced in October 2026 the acquisition of industrial land in Pulau Indah for approximately RM42.5 million for warehouse expansion, and held its 4th AGM on 27 November 2026 where all resolutions were passed. During the same period, Director Lok Kok Khong disposed 2.5 million shares during the closed period, while Director Wong Choong Loong acquired a total of 9.5 million shares. Latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) revenue was RM25.645 million with net profit of RM1.363 million.
notable_en: The company announced the acquisition of a 13-acre industrial land in Pulau Indah for approximately RM42.5 million for warehouse expansion.
The 4th AGM was held on 27 November 2026 and all resolutions were passed by shareholders.
Director Wong Choong Loong acquired a total of 9.5 million ordinary shares between 16 and 18 November 2026.
risks_en: Executive Director Lok Kok Khong disposed 2.5 million ordinary shares on 18 November 2026 during the closed period.
Latest quarter revenue declined 56.2% QoQ and net profit declined 80.2% QoQ.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM25.645 million, down 56.2% QoQ and 49.7% YoY; net profit was RM1.363 million, down 80.2% QoQ and 76.8% YoY; net margin was 5.3%, lower than 11.8% in the previous quarter.
